summary: Daily agent-space screening: vendor releases (Anthropic, OpenAI, JetBrains, Cloudflare) plus rising infra projects (Mastra, Omnigent, Kimi Code) and two operator reports (Claude Code setup, Jev experiment).

candidates.title: JetBrains Air: new system for agentic software development
candidates.why_it_matters: JetBrains launching integrated products for agent-driven development workflows.
candidates.next_check: watch IDE integrations, beta docs, and Copilot/GitHub plugin announcements

candidates.title: Anthropic: Claude Opus 5.5 with stricter cybersecurity safeguards
candidates.why_it_matters: Anthropic pushed product-level containment and tighter cybersecurity controls.
candidates.next_check: monitor technical containment details, security advisories, and Copilot integration reports

candidates.title: OpenAI: GPT-6 Sol & GPT-6 Luna announcements
candidates.why_it_matters: OpenAI published GPT-6 family posts announcing new models and prompt-caching work.
candidates.next_check: track availability, pricing, and SDK/CLI updates affecting agent runtimes

candidates.title: Cloudflare Worker Previews: isolated preview envs for agent actions
candidates.why_it_matters: Isolated preview environments can contain agent-generated changes and reduce blast radius.
candidates.next_check: watch adoption examples showing agent preview workflows and security notes

candidates.title: Mastra: TypeScript framework for AI apps and agents (popular repo)
candidates.why_it_matters: Widespread TypeScript framework may standardize agent app patterns and integrations.
candidates.next_check: seek second-source coverage (blog, release notes, or integrations) to corroborate repo traction

candidates.title: Omnigent: open meta-harness to orchestrate multiple agent engines
candidates.why_it_matters: Offers cross-harness orchestration, policy enforcement, and swap-and-run capability for agents.
candidates.next_check: monitor independent writeups, integrations, and adoption signals beyond GitHub stars

candidates.title: Kimi Code CLI — MoonshotAI starter CLI for next-gen agents
candidates.why_it_matters: CLI could become a common local entrypoint for coding agents and local workflows.
candidates.next_check: look for official release notes or community tutorials to corroborate usage

candidates.title: My Claude Code setup (11 commands, 3 agents) — operator walkthrough
candidates.why_it_matters: Concrete setup and commands illustrate real-world multi-agent developer workflow.
candidates.next_check: check for follow-up posts or GitHub dotfiles/recipes to reproduce setup

candidates.title: Jev 1.13 in Practice: decision model vs rules and local LLM
candidates.why_it_matters: Operator experiment compares latency, cost, and metrics of decision model vs local LLM.
candidates.next_check: seek reproducibility artifacts and held-out-set details to validate claims
